subject: Titan Systems: export screening hold for Q3 committed capacity + pricing exception request
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@titansys.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Titan Systems: export screening hold for Q3 committed capacity + pricing request

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Titan is keen to move forward with a Q3 committed capacity agreement. Our procurement team has a couple of blocking items before we can route to finance:

- Export classification: our product contains an AES acceleration component that our compliance team flagged as potentially dual-use under ECCN 5D002 depending on firmware. We need Redwood's export classification statement for the deployed inference runtime and an explicit confirmation you can support controls for EU-hosted deployments only.
- Commercial: procurement is requesting a 30% multi-year committed discount (3-year term) to lock in capacity pricing.

Attaching the product spec and a summary of our geo footprint. Can you fast-track a compliance review and confirm if the 30% discount is something Redwood can consider? Procurement would like a decision by EOD Friday to keep our Q3 timeline.

Attachments: titan_edge_spec_v3.pdf, titan_org_kex_declaration.xlsx

Best,
Emily Carter
Head of Procurement | Titan Systems
emily.carter@titansys.com
+44 20 7123 4567

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Titan Systems: export screening hold for Q3 committed capacity + pricing request

Team —

Forwarding Titan's ask. Key asks: 30% committed discount for a 3-year commit and export classification confirmation (possible ECCN flags). I have attached the spec they sent.

Request: can we get exec-level pricing signoff (if any) and a rapid export controls assessment? Legal/compliance are on the CC. Proposed interim response to Titan: we can proceed with EU-only hosting conditional on export sign-off and KYC completion; pricing to be confirmed after deal desk input.

What I need from you:
- Marcus: your recommendation on discount (floor and approval authority).
- Laura: if pricing override is required, do you want to approve a one-time concession and under what constraints?
- Compliance: can we have an ECCN check + sanctions screening by EOD Thu?

Deal details: DL-2027-089-TITAN — this would be a Dedicated capacity commit in EU-West with expected 100 GPU-hrs/day average.

Attachments: titan_edge_spec_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Titan Systems: export screening hold for Q3 committed capacity + pricing request

Olga / Laura —

Quick take from GTM: Titan is a strategic EU prospect and the volume is attractive, but 30% is outside our standard MOF for a first committed deal. Recommend the following compromise to keep timeline and protect unit economics: 

- Approve a 25% committed discount for EU-hosted Dedicated capacity for a 3-year term, contingent on:
  1) Positive export-classification assessment that confirms runtime is not controlled for export to licensed geos,
  2) Completed KYC and sanctions screening results,
  3) Inclusion of a performance SLA with rollback to standard pricing if usage patterns expand to non-EU geos.

If Laura signs off, sales can accept verbally and proceed to DocuSign with the MOF draft. If we need to go to 30%, this must be an exec-level concession (CEO/GM signoff) and include a revenue-protecting clause.

Marcus
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@redwood.ai>, Legal <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Titan Systems: export screening hold for Q3 committed capacity + pricing request

Mark / Olga —

I approve the 25% committed discount for EU-only deployments, subject to the following hard conditions: 

1) Compliance completes ECCN/classification and sanctions check with a green or mitigated outcome (no unrestricted export to sanctioned jurisdictions).
2) Legal to add a geo-restriction clause and an express audit right for export compliance in the contract.
3) Titan executes the DPA and provides org-level KYC (UBO + address verification) before countersign.

If any of the above are not satisfied, revert to standard pricing. No exceptions without CEO signoff.

Please communicate this to Titan and pause any DocuSign send until we have compliance confirmation.

Laura Bennett
SVP Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@titansys.com>, procurement@titansys.com

Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Titan Systems: export screening hold for Q3 committed capacity + pricing request

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the spec. Quick update and next steps:

- Pricing: Redwood can provisionally offer a 25% committed discount for EU-only Dedicated capacity on a 3-year term, contingent on compliance and legal sign-off (see conditions below). This is an interim commercial position pending final compliance clearance.

- Compliance requirements (items we need from Titan):
  * Completed KYC packet (UBO, company registration, authorized signers) — attach as a single PDF.
  * Confirmation that Titan will only deploy workloads to EU regions for this contract; any expansion outside the EU requires prior written consent and may trigger price recalculation.

- Next steps for us: Compliance will run ECCN/classification and sanctions screening (target ETA: Thu EOD). Legal will prepare geo-restriction and export audit language for the MOF. We will not send DocuSign until both teams return green/mitigated.

Attachments: pricing_MOF_draft.docx (provisional), titan_edge_spec_v3.pdf
Links: HubSpot deal DL-2027-089-TITAN (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/987654321)

We expect to update you by Friday with the compliance outcome. If you can send the KYC packet today that will help accelerate.

Regards,
